Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

This is the safety-tier review (Opus) that the draft comment asked for. I read the full diff, issue #3526 and the app caller against the current upstream/main `AGENTS.md`. I built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3875`. No GitHub runner was used.

- PR head: `07b9d2f9bca4f6756d61ee35519126060ae72e99`.
- Base: upstream/main `6d0381f1977b267885e22b3ddf55950b098fd319`.
- Trial merge: clean. Its first parent is the PR head.

## What looks good

- The refusal is correct for each input. The app gives `keepout_region(z, clearance_z.max(z))` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:515-524`). The height range of a lower level contains the range of a higher level, so its keep-out is the same or larger. Thus a blocked level is always below each cut level, and "the face would stop at Z <reached>" is true.
- `Tally::floor` is set at each level before the keep-out test (`face_keep.rs:122`). Thus Cut Z in the message is the real Cut Z, not the lowest cut level. Mutation 2 below pins this.
- The `?` fallback in `finish` cannot occur (`levels > 0` is checked first), and it does not panic. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is added outside tests.
- The refusal is a `GenError::Invalid`. It goes the same way as the existing "no safe facing room" refusal, which `do_not_touch_face` pins to block the post (no NC file).
- The turned frame (`boundary_turn::face_over_back`) turns only X and Y. The Z values in the message stay correct.
- The second call through `face_air_entry` (non-centre-cutting tools) uses the same `keep`, so it refuses in the same way.
- The decision file records what was chosen, why, and what was dropped. The provenance line stays. All files are below 400 lines (`face.rs` 392, `face_keep.rs` 144).
- The test goes into the existing `face_keep` suite. No new test binary.
- The commit body ends with `Fixes #3526`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and "Goldens moved: None".

## Results merged with main

The quick plan (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`) has 25 steps. The gate build step failed on this host with E0463 ("can't find crate") for dependency `.rmeta` files that exist. This is a host fault of the shared `target/`: a plain rebuild of `camcraft-motion` failed in the same way with no PR code changed. Thus I ran the same 23 suites directly with `cargo test` on the binaries that the first build made.

## Extra suites run

- Light lane, `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed (release build; motion lib, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, app `pocket_pass_start`).
- The three `example_catalog*` suites and the recorded-program suites (`solid_law_goldens`, `first_part_programs`) are in the table above. They passed, so no recorded program moved. This agrees with "Goldens moved: None".
- No file under `testdata/` and no importer changed. The extra fixture and importer rules select no more suites.
- Heavy lanes: not run. This is a `P3` PR. "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556) gives it no heavy step.

## Mutations

The pin is `face_keep::a_keepout_that_blocks_the_lower_levels_refuses_with_the_depth_reached`. I ran each mutation in a separate target directory and restored the file after it.

1. Replace `face_keep.rs` with the upstream/main version. Result: RED. The pin panicked at `face_keep.rs:110` (`unwrap_err()` got a partial toolpath).
2. Record the floor only for cut levels (move the `tally.floor` update into `Tally::cut`). Result: RED. The message said "Cut Z -1.000", and the "names Cut Z" assertion failed.

Without a mutation, the pin passes. The pin thus proves the refusal and the honest Cut Z.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge, not blocking)

1. P7: the site guide does not name the new refusal. Add it to the Face "Common refusals" in `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:93-95`.
2. P7: no app-level test uses a real model that is wider below the face. The motion pin uses a Z-dependent closure, and the PR body says so. An app test in `do_not_touch_face` would pin the full chain from the model to the refused post.
3. P7 (cosmetic): `format!("{v:.3}")` can print `-0.000` for a level at Z 0.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
